bio: If you’re keen to try some authentic yet innovative Japanese cuisine, this restaurant bearing the signature of famous culinary maestro Hideki Matsuhisa, who has already tasted major success at Koy Shunka in Barcelona, is definitely this place. The Japanese-Mediterranean philosophy here is one that is not based on a fusion approach; instead, it is more of a reproduction of Japanese techniques but with the use of essentially Mediterranean ingredients, with addition of others from Galicia and Huelva.
